verdict.rationale: Helicone lets developers build against the familiar OpenAI SDK through its AI Gateway, and integrates in one line with the OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini and Vercel AI SDKs. Community users confirm the one-line swap. A REST API with a published OpenAPI spec also supports programmatic access. However, these are third-party provider SDKs plus a raw REST surface, not Helicone-owned SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of first-party Helicone SDK packages (language coverage, versioning, SDK reference docs) for the platform's own features such as querying, prompts and sessions.
